# hyperlite_vm_snapshot (Resource)

A snapshot of a VM (with its memory when it runs, on a qcow2 disk; disk only on ZFS). Destroying the resource deletes the snapshot; it never restores it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hyperlite_vm_snapshot" "before_upgrade" {
  vm          = hyperlite_vm.web.name
  name        = "before-upgrade"
  description = "Taken before the 13.2 upgrade"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The snapshot's name.
- `vm` (String) The VM.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Its description.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When it was taken.
- `id` (String) `<vm>/<snapshot>`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import hyperlite_vm_snapshot.before_upgrade web-1/before-upgrade
```
